contexts.text: Then such (goods and truths) appear to him both obscure and undelightful.
In the same degree he feels what is undelightful in the evils of his former life, and what is unpleasant in the falsities of it.
If they should withdraw their senses from worldly things, they would perceive what is undelightful...
They feel what is undelightful in staying longer, and thus depart in freedom.
If they are remitted into Societies not in accord, they perceive what is undelightful; and, from what is undelightful, what is compulsory...
These delights cause these (spiritual things) to appear joyless and undelightful...
(The conversation of these Spirits causes an influx into the man) of what is undelightful, etc. SE 4597. SE 4645:end. SE 5942.
Bitter things = things undelightful, here, those of temptations. Illustrated. AC 8349.
That truths appeared undelightful to them because they were devoid of the affection of good. Signified, Explained. AC 8352.
As soon as evil begins to predominate... at once, instead of truth, there is felt what is undelightful. Explained.
It is the delight of love which is good to man; and the undelight which is evil to him.
In Hell their delight is turned into undelight.
At last he feels these (fleshly delights) as undelightful...
That interiorly (truth) was undelightful, because exteriorly it was adulterated. Signified, Explained.
